description: This file defines the UseTokenParser class which handles the parsing of 'use' statements in Twig templates for importing blocks from other templates, enabling template inheritance and reuse.

classes.name: UseTokenParser
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractTokenParser, responsible for parsing 'use' tags in Twig templates to import blocks from other templates.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses the 'use' tag, processes the expression referencing the template, and handles optional target blocks with aliases, returning an EmptyNode.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the string tag name 'use' that this parser handles.
